# Mapped consumer factories

A binary mapper consumes one method formal and produces a second formal. The
next unary carrier consumes that second formal, while the returned carrier
retains the first. Method scope remains independent of the generic interface
that declares the static factory.

An owned factory publishes original inputs and returns an opaque configured
result. A second entry invokes the real JDK comparing factory. Frozen callers
check callback order, nulls, mutable input snapshots, future implementation
bridges, delayed casts and exact checked/runtime/Error identity. Both source
and SDK layouts compile every output unit and compare original definitions
and compiler metadata.
